# Fachry Nuzuli Kamal

> Product builder teaching non-technical people how to build in this economy

Based in Riau, Indonesia. Sr Product Manager (Digital Transformation Lead), APRIL Group, Transport Division. Bachelor of Economics, USU (Universitas Sumatera Utara, 2020). Native in Bahasa Indonesia; fluent in English.

## Complete Dossier (Single-File Context)

- [Complete Profile & Dossier](https://fachrynuzuli.com/llms-full.txt): Full structured biography, chronological career arc (then and now), works and prototypes, writings, daily stack, verified impact figures, principles, and canonical index.

## Core Pages & Live Publication

- [Home (fachrynuzuli.com)](https://fachrynuzuli.com/): Interactive personal website with full semantic dossier covering About, Journey, Works, Writings, Resources, and Connect.
- [In This Economy](https://in.thisecono.my/): Live static web book on navigating economic turbulence, building asymmetric leverage with AI, and owning a piece of a business.
- [Mini-essay (fachry.bearblog.dev)](https://fachry.bearblog.dev/): Minimal, fast essays on career strategy, product work, and mental models.
- [Newsletter (fachry.substack.com)](https://fachry.substack.com/): Long-form newsletter archive on AI building, influence, and personal leverage.

## Live Apps, Prototypes & Agent Skills (11 Projects)

- [FLS Dashboard](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/fls-dashboard): Real-time performance monitoring dashboard for port cargo loading operations ([Live](https://fachrynuzuli.github.io/fls-dashboard/) | [Repo](https://github.com/fachrynuzuli/fls-dashboard)).
- [Dispatch System (FDS)](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/dispatch-system): AI-first logistics supply chain intelligence and fleet dispatch optimization prototype powered by Gemini ([Demo](https://fachrynuzuli.com/demos/dispatch-system/) | [Repo](https://github.com/fachrynuzuli/dispatch-system)).
- [Profilemu](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/profilemu): AI digital twin web app letting visitors converse directly with a professional's background and expertise ([Live](https://profile.fachrynuzuli.com/) | [Repo](https://github.com/fachrynuzuli/profilemu)).
- [Guru Nyanyi (Vocalist)](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/guru-nyanyi): Beginner-friendly vocal practice web app built for shy learners ([Live](https://sing.fachrynuzuli.com/) | [Repo](https://github.com/fachrynuzuli/guru-nyanyi)).
- [Knock-Knock](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/knock-knock): Gamified team management and weekly task reporting app styled as an interactive neighborhood ([Demo](https://fachrynuzuli.com/demos/knock-knock/) | [Repo](https://github.com/fachrynuzuli/knock-knock)).
- [Household](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/household): Mobile-first household organizer and daily family coordination web app ([Live](https://house.fachrynuzuli.com/)).
- [Scaler](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/scaler): Interactive business and career scaling companion web app ([Live](https://scaler.fachrynuzuli.com/)).
- [Find 'N Keep](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/find-n-keep): Lightweight discovery capture and retrieval web app ([Live](https://findandkeep.netlify.app/)).
- [BRD Builder](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/brd-builder): Coding-agent skill interviewing stakeholders and generating styled Business Requirement Documents ([SKILL.md](https://fachrynuzuli.com/skills/brd-builder.md) | [Repo](https://github.com/fachrynuzuli/brd-builder)).
- [Sharemaxxing](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/sharemaxxing): Agent skill encoding the Shareability Engine and Voice DNA rules for high-influence writing ([SKILL.md](https://fachrynuzuli.com/skills/sharemaxxing.md) | [Repo](https://github.com/fachrynuzuli/sharemaxxing)).
- [Lovable Framework](https://fachrynuzuli.com/#works/lovable-framework): 149-entry Lovable Prompt Library coding-agent skill covering 17 Prompting Strategy guides, 78 Design recipes, and 54 Functionality recipes ([SKILL.md](https://fachrynuzuli.com/skills/lovable-framework.md)).
